require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'rack/utils'

set :environment, :production

MAX_PASSWORD_BYTES = 72

class TokenBucket
  def initialize(capacity, refill_rate)
    @capacity = capacity
    @refill_rate = refill_rate
    @buckets = {}
  end

  def allow?(key)
    now = Time.now.to_f
    bucket = @buckets[key] ||= { tokens: @capacity.to_f, last: now }
    elapsed = now - bucket[:last]
    bucket[:tokens] = [bucket[:tokens] + elapsed * @refill_rate, @capacity.to_f].min
    bucket[:last] = now
    if bucket[:tokens] >= 1.0
      bucket[:tokens] -= 1.0
      true
    else
      false
    end
  end
end

class UserDirectory
  attr_reader :users

  def initialize
    @users = {}
  end

  def register(email, password, role)
    # Normalize email at registration time - single canonical form
    canonical = normalize_email(email)
    # Reject if normalized form already exists (prevent collisions)
    return nil if @users[canonical]
    hashed = BCrypt::Password.create(password, cost: 12)
    user_id = SecureRandom.uuid
    @users[canonical] = { id: user_id, email: canonical, password: hashed, role: role }
    user_id
  end

  def find_by_email(email)
    canonical = normalize_email(email)
    @users[canonical]
  end

  def authenticate(email, password)
    user = find_by_email(email)
    return nil unless user
    return nil unless BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password]) == password
    user
  end

  private

  def normalize_email(email)
    # NFC normalization then downcase for consistent comparison
    email.to_s.unicode_normalize(:nfc).downcase.strip
  end
end

class SessionManager
  def initialize
    @sessions = {}
  end

  def create(user_id, role, ip_addr)
    sid = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    @sessions[sid] = {
      user_id: user_id,
      role: role,
      ip_addr: ip_addr,
      csrf_token: SecureRandom.hex(24),
      created_at: Time.now.to_i,
      last_access: Time.now.to_i
    }
    sid
  end

  def get(sid)
    session = @sessions[sid]
    return nil unless session
    # Session expiry: 30 minutes
    if Time.now.to_i - session[:last_access] > 1800
      @sessions.delete(sid)
      return nil
    end
    session[:last_access] = Time.now.to_i
    session
  end

  def destroy(sid)
    @sessions.delete(sid)
  end

  def regenerate(old_sid, user_id, role, ip_addr)
    destroy(old_sid) if old_sid
    create(user_id, role, ip_addr)
  end
end

# Initialize components
@@directory = UserDirectory.new
@@sessions = SessionManager.new
@@rate_limiter = TokenBucket.new(5, 0.1)

# Seed users
@@directory.register("admin@corp.example.com", "Xt9#mK2$vL5n", "admin")
@@directory.register("analyst@corp.example.com", "Bp4&jR8!wQ3z", "analyst")
@@directory.register("viewer@corp.example.com", "guest1234", "readonly")

helpers do
  def current_session
    sid = request.cookies['_sess_id']
    return nil unless sid
    @@sessions.get(sid)
  end

  def require_auth!(min_role)
    session = current_session
    halt 401, json_error('Authentication required') unless session
    role_level = { 'admin' => 100, 'analyst' => 50, 'readonly' => 10 }[session[:role]] || 0
    required_level = { 'admin' => 100, 'analyst' => 50, 'readonly' => 10 }[min_role] || 0
    halt 403, json_error('Insufficient privileges') unless role_level >= required_level
    session
  end

  def json_error(msg)
    JSON.generate({ error: msg })
  end

  def validate_csrf!(session)
    token = request.env['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN']
    unless token && Rack::Utils.secure_compare(token, session[:csrf_token])
      halt 403, json_error('CSRF validation failed')
    end
  end
end

before do
  content_type :json
end

post '/auth/login' do
  unless @@rate_limiter.allow?(request.ip)
    halt 429, json_error('Rate limited')
  end

  begin
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  rescue
    halt 400, json_error('Invalid JSON')
  end

  email = body['email'].to_s
  password = body['password'].to_s

  halt 400, json_error('Email required') if email.empty?
  halt 400, json_error('Password required') if password.empty?
  # Guard against bcrypt silent truncation at 72 bytes
  halt 400, json_error('Password too long') if password.bytesize > MAX_PASSWORD_BYTES

  # Authenticate: find user by normalized email
  user = @@directory.authenticate(email, password)
  halt 401, json_error('Invalid credentials') unless user

  # Regenerate session to prevent fixation
  old_sid = request.cookies['_sess_id']
  new_sid = @@sessions.regenerate(old_sid, user[:id], user[:role], request.ip)

  response.set_cookie('_sess_id', {
    value: new_sid,
    httponly: true,
    secure: true,
    same_site: :strict,
    path: '/'
  })

  JSON.generate({ status: 'authenticated', role: user[:role], csrf_token: @@sessions.get(new_sid)[:csrf_token] })
end

post '/auth/logout' do
  session = current_session
  if session
    sid = request.cookies['_sess_id']
    @@sessions.destroy(sid)
    response.delete_cookie('_sess_id')
  end
  JSON.generate({ status: 'logged_out' })
end

get '/api/profile' do
  session = require_auth!('readonly')
  user_entry = @@directory.users.values.find { |u| u[:id] == session[:user_id] }
  JSON.generate({ email: user_entry[:email], role: session[:role] })
end

post '/api/reports/generate' do
  session = require_auth!('analyst')
  validate_csrf!(session)

  begin
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  rescue
    halt 400, json_error('Invalid JSON')
  end

  report_type = body['type'].to_s
  allowed_types = ['financial', 'audit', 'compliance']
  halt 400, json_error('Invalid report type') unless allowed_types.include?(report_type)

  JSON.generate({ status: 'generated', report_id: SecureRandom.uuid, type: report_type })
end

post '/admin/users/elevate' do
  session = require_auth!('admin')
  validate_csrf!(session)

  begin
    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  rescue
    halt 400, json_error('Invalid JSON')
  end

  target_email = body['email'].to_s
  new_role = body['role'].to_s

  allowed_roles = ['analyst', 'readonly']
  halt 400, json_error('Invalid role') unless allowed_roles.include?(new_role)

  target = @@directory.find_by_email(target_email)
  halt 404, json_error('User not found') unless target

  target[:role] = new_role
  JSON.generate({ status: 'elevated', email: target[:email], new_role: new_role })
end
